en: The Question on the Existence of the Fruit of Karma.
"Venerable Nāgasena, by means of this name-and-form (nāmarūpa), wholesome or unwholesome karma has been performed; where do those karmas abide?
"Those karmas would follow it, O Great King, like a shadow that never departs."
“But is it possible, venerable sir, to point out those karmas, saying, ‘Those karmas remain here or there’?
“It is not possible, great king, to point out those karmas, saying, ‘Those karmas remain here or there.
“What do you think, great king? Is it possible to point out the fruits of these trees that have not yet produced fruit, saying, ‘The fruits are here or there’?
“In the same way, great king, as long as the continuity [of consciousness] is unbroken, it is not possible to point out those kamma-formations, saying, ‘Those kamma-formations are here or there.’”
This is the eighth problem: the existence of the fruit of kamma.
